blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `retrieveOrderLineItem` method. This belongs to the Order Module.
You should only use this methods when implementing complex customizations. For common cases, check out [available workflows instead](/medusa-workflows-reference).
This method retrieves a line item by its ID.

A simple example that retrieves an order change by its ID:

```ts
const lineItem = await orderModuleService.retrieveOrderLineItem("123")
```

To specify relations that should be retrieved:

You can only retrieve data models defined in the same module. To retrieve linked data models
from other modules, use [Query](https://docs.medusajs.com/learn/fundamentals/module-links/query) instead.

types.name: config
types.description:
The configurations determining how the line item is retrieved. Its properties, such as `select` or `relations`, accept the
attributes or relations associated with a line item.

children.name: select
children.description: An array of strings, each being attribute names of the entity to retrieve in the result.

children.name: skip
children.description: A number indicating the number of records to skip before retrieving the results.

children.name: take
children.description: A number indicating the number of records to return in the result.

children.name: relations
children.description:
An array of strings, each being relation names of the entity to retrieve in the result.

You can only retrieve data models defined in the same module. To retrieve linked data models
from other modules, use [Query](https://docs.medusajs.com/learn/fundamentals/module-links/query) instead.

children.name: order
children.description:
An object used to specify how to sort the returned records. Its keys are the names of attributes of the entity, and a key's value can either be `ASC`
to sort retrieved records in an ascending order, or `DESC` to sort retrieved records in a descending order.

children.name: withDeleted
children.description:
A boolean indicating whether deleted records should also be retrieved as part of the result. This only works if the entity extends the
`SoftDeletableEntity` class.

children.name: filters
children.description: Enable ORM specific defined filters

children.name: options
children.description: Enable ORM specific defined options

types.name: sharedContext
types.description: A context used to share resources, such as transaction manager, between the application and the module.

children.name: transactionManager
children.description: An instance of a transaction manager of type `TManager`, which is a typed parameter passed to the context to specify the type of the `transactionManager`.

children.name: manager
children.description: An instance of a manager, typically an entity manager, of type `TManager`, which is a typed parameter passed to the context to specify the type of the `manager`.

children.name: isolationLevel
children.description: A string indicating the isolation level of the context. Possible values are `READ UNCOMMITTED`, `READ COMMITTED`, `REPEATABLE READ`, or `SERIALIZABLE`.

children.name: enableNestedTransactions
children.description: A boolean value indicating whether nested transactions are enabled.

children.name: eventGroupId
children.description: A string indicating the ID of the group to aggregate the events to be emitted at a later point.

children.name: transactionId
children.description: A string indicating the ID of the current transaction.

If true, the parent step will not be triggered by the sub workflow.

types.description: This method retrieves a line item by its ID.
types.example: A simple example that retrieves an order change by its ID:const lineItem = await orderModuleService.retrieveOrderLineItem("123")To specify relations that should be retrieved: :::note You can only retrieve data models defined in the same module. To retrieve linked data models from other modules, use [Query](https://docs.medusajs.com/learn/fundamentals/module-links/query) instead. :::const lineItem = await orderModuleService.retrieveOrderLineItem( "123", { relations: ["order"] } )
